outcome: Pre-phototherapy TSB percentile levels at 24 hours of age
cohort: A cohort of 642 extremely preterm infants born at 240/7 to 286/7 weeks' gestation, between January 2013 and June 2017, across three NICUs in Canada.
finding: Statistically derived pre-phototherapy total serum bilirubin levels in extremely preterm infants showed notable differences when compared to currently published consensus-based thresholds for phototherapy.
